haskell.name: partialIntCase
haskell.type: forall r. Int -> r -> r -> (Int -> r) -> r
haskell.definition: \n negative zero positive -> if n < 0 then negative else if n == 0 then zero else positive (n - 1)

lean.name: BehaviorPartialNumeric.intCase

original_provider_inventory.rationale: A generic negative/zero/positive-predecessor Int eliminator. A Church list can fold to Int -> a; no list selector or target implementation is supplied.
